sticky-brain.note: Electron app (npm run dev launches the desktop window, not a localhost URL). JARVIS starts it; no browser tab to open.

irimsv.note: No live Vite repo found on disk (only backups). 'path' points at the backup folder so the entry validates. JARVIS opens the cloud dev server and auto-logs in with the vault creds (wiki/secrets/iRIMS-V). Set 'path' to the real repo once cloned; remove 'vault_secret' if you'd rather sign in by hand.
